notes.title: Blood Midnight Blossom Demo released!
notes.notes:
Hello, Observers! I have news!

The demo for the festival is out. And it's great! It turned out more raw than I expected, but for the next 7 days I plan to update it daily and eventually get to the original idea!

So don't get lost, everything will be there and at its best, stay tuned!
